gaps.sentence: The 1990s was the decade ___ mobile phones became common.

gaps.sentence: The bridge, on ___ repairs are still continuing, will reopen in May.

gaps.sentence: My laptop, ___ I bought only last year, has already crashed twice.

gaps.sentence: I will always remember the summer ___ we cycled along the Danube.

gaps.sentence: The restaurant ___ we had dinner last night has excellent reviews.
